bird.name: Numfor leaf warbler
bird.blurb:
The Numfor leaf warbler is a species of Old World warbler in the family Phylloscopidae.
It is endemic to Numfor in Indonesia.

wiki.title: 1986 New York Mets season
wiki.extract: The 1986 New York Mets season was the 25th season for the New York Mets as a franchise of Major League Baseball, and their 22nd season playing at Shea Stadium in the Queens borough. The team was managed by Davey Johnson, with their general manager being Frank Cashen. The Mets won the National League East, National League Championship Series (NLCS) and the 1986 World Series, the team's second and most recent World Series championship. At 108 wins and 54 losses, the Mets recorded one of the best regular season records in MLB history.
